videos.title: Is This Rally a Trap? The Market Crash Explained (Software, PayPal, & Fubo)
videos.description:
The market just went through a sharp sell-off — especially in technology and software stocks — and a lot of investors are asking the same question right now:

Is this the start of a bigger market crash… or just a short-term panic?

In this video, I break down what actually happened during this week’s market pullback, why SaaS and software stocks were hit the hardest, and how I’m personally thinking about risk, diversification, and opportunity going forward.

I also go deep on the two stocks many of you are most worried about right now:

PayPal (PYPL) and FuboTV (FUBO) — both of which sold off hard after earnings.

We’ll walk through:

what the market is really reacting to,

what’s noise vs. real fundamental risk,

and how I’m positioning my portfolio after the selloff and Friday’s rebound.

This is not a trading video.
This is a fundamentals-driven look at what matters after a panic week.

If you’re a long-term investor trying to stay rational during a volatile market, this video is for you.

📌 In this video:

00:00 – The Market Crash Explained
What actually caused the selloff and why tech and software stocks led the decline.

01:33 – Real Investing
How I think about risk, fear, and decision-making during market drawdowns.

12:30 – The SaaS Meltdown
Why software stocks are under pressure right now and what investors are missing about AI and agentic tools.

20:28 – PayPal Earnings Crash (PYPL)
What went wrong, what didn’t, and how I’m evaluating PayPal after the selloff.

37:18 – FuboTV Breakdown (FUBO)
The real business story after earnings and why the long-term case looks very different than the headline reaction.

48:54 – Portfolio Moves & Watchlist
What I’m buying, what I’m watching, and how I’m positioning for upcoming earnings.

This video covers:
market crash analysis, stock market selloff, tech stocks, SaaS stocks, software stocks, AI and agentic automation, PayPal stock, PYPL earnings, Fubo stock, FUBO earnings, portfolio strategy, diversification, and long-term investing during market volatility.

In this video, I break down the recent earnings reports for PayPal ($PYPL) and Google ($GOOGL $GOOG). PayPal shares have dropped over 22% following missed estimates and weak guidance, while Google crushed expectations. I discuss my personal portfolio moves: why I am holding strong on PayPal despite the fear, and why I decided to take profits on Google after its massive run-up.

I also share wisdom from Warren Buffett's 2011 shareholder letter regarding stock buybacks and how it applies to PayPal's current situation.

Key Topics Covered:

PayPal (PYPL): Branded checkout growth, CEO transition (Alex Chriss to Enrique Lores), and 2026 guidance.

Google (GOOGL): Earnings beat, RSI bearish divergence, and portfolio rebalancing.
